label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Y harás altar de quemar incienso; maderas de shitím harás a él.
spanish: Y harás altar de quemar incienso; maderas de acacia harás a él.
grammarChanges: Replaced the untranslated transliteration "shitím" (h02030001006, שִׁטִּים, common noun fem. plural) with its Spanish rendering "acacia," matching the established rendering of this same noun elsewhere in this chapter (e.g. v.5, v.10, v.24, v.28).
